purpose: Qualify closed classic 2D POLYLINE geometry through AC1021 DWG writing, installed dwg2dxf conversion and FreeCAD native C++ DXF import.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch in /tmp; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

convertedDxf.recordCheck: The generated profile is imported through FreeCAD's exact installed-converter subprocess; closed-wire topology and ordered WCS points pass.

consumer.route: FreeCAD Draft DWG open/insert -> hash-checked installed dwg2dxf -> C++ DXF importer

validation.fixturePolicy: Generated DWG/DXF files stay in isolated temporary directories; no fixture is added.

limitations: This qualifies one generated AC1021 closed classic 2D POLYLINE on FreeCAD 1.1.4 macOS ARM64 only.

Physical producer breadth, FreeCAD 1.1.3/Linux/Windows, other legacy POLYLINE flags, complete document output and broad application semantics remain open. It does not resolve the separate closed classic 3D POLYLINE gap.
supportClaimEffect: Adds bounded consumer evidence for the generated closed classic 2D POLYLINE profile; no broad format-support claim is promoted.
